entities.name: T3346 value
entities.description: An information element that carries the T3346 timer value, included by the MME when general NAS level mobility management congestion control is active.

entities.name: MME
entities.description: Mobility Management Entity that may include the T3346 value IE when congestion control is active.

entities.name: General NAS level mobility management congestion control active
entities.description: Condition indicating that general NAS level mobility management congestion control is active.

relations.description: The MME may include the T3346 value IE in messages when congestion control is active.
The inclusion of the T3346 value IE is guarded by the condition that general NAS level mobility management congestion control is active.
